study: Design Theory single-page marketing case study
feedback: none before frozen first delivery; self-tests allowed
sample: one shared project, one independently fresh build per arm; no general statistical claim
primaryQualityOutcome: actual user blinded overall A/B/tie preference; no fabricated ratings; synthetic critique diagnostic only

humanReview.identity: requesting user if they choose to rate
humanReview.stoppingRule: all three pair comparisons once, no optional sampling until a win
humanReview.adoptionThreshold: none for general superiority; one case study cannot establish it

cost: numeric evaluations and renderer work separately
exclusions: no post-outcome exclusions; incomplete/failed builds remain outcomes; technical pre-turn setup failures retained separately
isolation: fresh /private/tmp workspaces, suppressed inherited skills/MCP/plugins/memories, identical model/config; instruction and trace audit unless stronger read denial verified
freeze: snapshot source/public/report immediately on first final turn completion; no evaluator repairs
limits: one project does not establish general benefit
token totals across different model tokenizers are not pooled as equivalent cost
cached input already included in input
cannot claim human preference before actual observations
